svg.title: From forecast to reported claim count: Bohemia, 1988 and 1990
svg.desc: Original evidence infographic. September 1988 DNR notice estimated 26,000 applications and expected 12,000 fee-paying applications. March 1990 DNR fiscal impact statement reported 26,000 claims already received, but estimated up to 8,000 might qualify for indigence consideration and a 450,000 dollar deposit shortfall. The numbers do not establish approved claims, actual indigence awards, fee receipts, or restitution.
